desc: Two hot-pluggable systems (nodes) in a 2U form factor. Each node supports the following:
AMD Ryzen™ Threadripper™ PRO 5000WX/3000WX Series Processor, up to 64 Cores
2TB Registered ECC DDR4 3200MHz SDRAM in 8 DIMMs
Up to 6 PCI-E Gen 4 x16 (4 internal, 2 external) slots, 1 PCI-E 4.0 x8 AIOM slot M.2 Interface: 2 PCI-E 4.0 x4, M.2 Form Factor: 2280, 2210, M.2 Key: M-key
Integrated IPMI 2.0 + KVM with dedicated LAN Software Out of Band License key (SFT-OOB-LIC) included for OOB BIOS management
2 front Hot-swap 2.5" U.2 NVMe Gen4 drive bays
2600W Redundant (1+1) Power Supplies Titanium Level (96%) (Full redundancy based on configuration and application load)

PSE-TRPR5995WX-0444.d: Ryzen Threadripper PRO, UP 64C/128T 2.7G 256M 280W SP3, HF, RoHS

PSE-TRPR5975WX-0445.d: Ryzen Threadripper PRO, UP 32C/64T 3.6G 128M 280W SP3, HF, RoHS

HDS-25N4-015T3-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 15.3TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-007T6-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 7.6TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-003T8-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 3.8TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-001T9-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 1.9TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-960G0-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 960GB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

AOC-A25G-B2SM-P.d: AIOM 2-port 25GbE SFP28, Broadcom BCM57414 with 0.5U bracket

AOC-AG-I2M-P.d: AIOM 2-port 1GbE RJ45, Intel i350-AM2 with 0.5U Bracket

AOC-ATG-I2SM-P.d: AIOM Dual-Port 10GbE SFP+, based on X710-BM2 with 0.5U Bracket,RoHS

GPU-AMDMI210-PCIE-0008H.d: AMD Instinct MI210 PCIe 64GB 300W HBM2e PCIe Gen4

AOM-TPM-9670V-P.d: SPI capable vertical TPM 2.0 provisioned for server,RoHS

SFT-SDDC-SINGLE.d: SuperCloud Composer (SCC) for Rack Scale Management for Air Cooled Server, security and service integrated features like attestation, call-home. Node License, Up to Gen14, 3 YEARS support

SFT-DCMS-SINGLE.d: System Management capabilities for data centers, Node License, Up to Gen14, 3 YEARS support
